id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:stop reporting transient body read failures as noise

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific failure reason ('response_body_read') to client-request failure tracking, potentially distinguishing transient wire truncation from backend parsing errors.
review.reason: Adds a new error class and a specific failure reason to the client-request failure capture, while excluding it from standard API failure suppression. This could help distinguish transient wire truncation from backend parsing errors.
